import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final double EPS = 1e-9;
    static final double PI = Math.acos(-1.0);
    static final int MOD = 1000000007;
    static final int INF = 2000000000;
    static final int MAXN = 210;
    static final int MAXM = 2 * MAXN * MAXN;
    static final int[] dx = {1, 0, 0, -1};
    static final int[] dy = {0, 1, -1, 0};
    static final int SRC = MAXN - 2;
    static final int DST = MAXN - 1;

    static class Dinic {
        int[] to = new int[MAXM];
        int[] flow = new int[MAXM];
        int[] cap = new int[MAXM];
        int edgeIdx = 0;

        List<Integer>[] adj = new List[MAXN];
        boolean[] vis = new boolean[MAXN];

        Dinic() {
            for (int i = 0; i < MAXN; i++) {
                adj[i] = new ArrayList<>();
            }
        }

        void link(int u, int v, int c) {
            to[edgeIdx] = v;
            flow[edgeIdx] = 0;
            cap[edgeIdx] = c;
            adj[u].add(edgeIdx++);
            
            to[edgeIdx] = u;
            flow[edgeIdx] = 0;
            cap[edgeIdx] = 0;
            adj[v].add(edgeIdx++);
        }

        boolean path(int node, int dest, int amt) {
            if (node == dest) return true;
            vis[node] = true;

            for (int i : adj[node]) {
                if (!vis[to[i]] && cap[i] - flow[i] >= amt && path(to[i], dest, amt)) {
                    flow[i] += amt;
                    flow[i ^ 1] -= amt;
                    return true;
                }
            }
            return false;
        }

        int maxFlow(int src, int dst) {
            int amt = 1 << 30;
            int total = 0;

            while (amt > 0) {
                if (path(src, dst, amt)) {
                    total += amt;
                } else {
                    amt >>= 1;
                }
                Arrays.fill(vis, false);
            }
            return total;
        }
    }

    static Dinic dinic = new Dinic();

    static int N, K;
    static char[][] gridA = new char[15][15];
    static char[][] gridB = new char[15][15];
    static int[][] distMap = new int[15][15];
    static boolean[][] visitedMap = new boolean[15][15];

    static boolean valid(int x, int y) {
        return 0 <= x && x < N &&
               0 <= y && y < N &&
               gridA[x][y] != 'Y' &&
               gridA[x][y] != 'Z';
    }

    static void bfsFromZ(int sx, int sy) {
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++)
            for (int j = 0; j < N; j++)
                distMap[i][j] = INF;

        Queue<Integer> qx = new LinkedList<>();
        Queue<Integer> qy = new LinkedList<>();
        distMap[sx][sy] = 0;
        qx.add(sx);
        qy.add(sy);

        while (!qx.isEmpty()) {
            int cx = qx.poll();
            int cy = qy.poll();

            for (int k = 0; k < 4; k++) {
                int nx = cx + dx[k];
                int ny = cy + dy[k];
                if (valid(nx, ny) && distMap[nx][ny] == INF) {
                    distMap[nx][ny] = distMap[cx][cy] + 1;
                    qx.add(nx);
                    qy.add(ny);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static void bfsFromSource(int sx, int sy) {
        Queue<Integer> qx = new LinkedList<>();
        Queue<Integer> qy = new LinkedList<>();
        Queue<Integer> qlev = new LinkedList<>();
        Arrays.fill(visitedMap[0], false);
        for (int i = 1; i < 15; i++) {
            System.arraycopy(visitedMap[0], 0, visitedMap[i], 0, 15);
        }

        visitedMap[sx][sy] = true;
        qx.add(sx);
        qy.add(sy);
        qlev.add(0);

        while (!qx.isEmpty()) {
            int cx = qx.poll();
            int cy = qy.poll();
            int lev = qlev.poll();

            if (Character.isDigit(gridB[cx][cy]) && gridB[cx][cy] != '0') {
                dinic.link(sx * N + sy, N * N + 1 + cx * N + cy, INF);
            }

            if (lev >= K) continue;

            for (int k = 0; k < 4; k++) {
                int nx = cx + dx[k];
                int ny = cy + dy[k];

                if (valid(nx, ny) && !visitedMap[nx][ny]) {
                    if (distMap[nx][ny] > lev + 1) {
                        qx.add(nx);
                        qy.add(ny);
                        qlev.add(lev + 1);
                    } else if (distMap[nx][ny] > lev && Character.isDigit(gridB[nx][ny]) && gridB[nx][ny] != '0') {
                        dinic.link(sx * N + sy, N * N + 1 + nx * N + ny, INF);
                    }
                    visitedMap[nx][ny] = true;
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static void buildNetwork() {
        int sx = -1, sy = -1;
        for (int i = 0; i < N && sx == -1; i++)
            for (int j = 0; j < N && sx == -1; j++)
                if (gridA[i][j] == 'Z') {
                    sx = i; sy = j;
                }

        bfsFromZ(sx, sy);

        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++)
            for (int j = 0; j < N; j++)
                if (Character.isDigit(gridA[i][j]) && gridA[i][j] != '0')
                    dinic.link(SRC, i * N + j, gridA[i][j] - '0');

        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++)
            for (int j = 0; j < N; j++)
                if (Character.isDigit(gridB[i][j]) && gridB[i][j] != '0')
                    dinic.link(i * N + j + N * N + 1, DST, gridB[i][j] - '0');

        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++)
            for (int j = 0; j < N; j++)
                if (Character.isDigit(gridA[i][j]) && gridA[i][j] != '0')
                    bfsFromSource(i, j);
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        System.setIn(new FileInputStream("in"));
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        
        N = sc.nextInt();
        K = sc.nextInt();
        sc.nextLine();
        
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            gridA[i] = sc.nextLine().toCharArray();
        }
        sc.nextLine();
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            gridB[i] = sc.nextLine().toCharArray();
        }

        buildNetwork();
        System.out.println(dinic.maxFlow(SRC, DST));
    }
}
